retrieved_context: Dorothea Jordan: Dorothea Jordan (22 November 17615 July 1816) was an Anglo-Irish actress, courtesan, and the mistress and companion of the future King William IV of the United Kingdom, for 20 years while he was Duke of Clarence.  Together they had ten illegitimate children, all of whom took the surname "FitzClarence".

Lady Mary Fox: Lady Mary Fox (née FitzClarence; 19 December 1798 – 13 July 1864) was an illegitimate daughter of King William IV of the United Kingdom by his mistress Dorothea Jordan.  In later life she became a writer.

Lady Augusta Gordon: Lady Augusta Gordon ("née" FitzClarence; 17 November 1803 – 8 December 1865) was a British noblewoman.  Born the fourth illegitimate daughter of William IV of the United Kingdom (then Duke of Clarence) by his long-time mistress Dorothea Jordan, she grew up at their Bushy House residence in Teddington.  Augusta had four sisters and five brothers all surnamed FitzClarence.  Soon after their father became monarch, the FitzClarence children were raised to the ranks of younger children of a marquess.
